Aegis Series-7 Hydraulic Control System
Alarm Reference
Document AEG-AL-700   |   Revision 5 (incorporates ECN-1058)
Alarm
Condition
Panel
Indication
Possible Cause(s)
Required Action
A17
Hydraulic pressure
below 150 bar
RED
1. IV-21 closed or
partially closed
2. Low hydraulic fluid
3. Pressure sensor
signal invalid
See Section 4 of the
Maintenance Manual.
If persistent > 10 s,
run Shutdown Proc. 4.7*
A18
Hydraulic pressure
above 220 bar
AMBER
1. Relief valve fault
2. Setpoint
misconfiguration
Stop the HPU. Do not
restart until pressure
relief is verified.
A19
Pressure sensor
signal invalid
RED
1. Sensor wiring fault
2. Sensor drift beyond
tolerance (see ECN-1042)
Replace sensor per
Maintenance Manual
Section 6.
* Shutdown Procedure 4.7 applies only when A17 persists beyond 10 seconds. A transient A17 that clears on its own during normal valve
transition does not require Procedure 4.7 (see Maintenance Manual AEG-MM-700, Section 4).
Note on sensor references: prior to Revision 5 of this document, the condition for A17 referenced sensor PS-04
by name. Per ECN-1058, the condition is evaluated against whichever pressure sensor is active for the installed
software revision (PS-04 or PS-04A). The 150 bar and 220 bar thresholds shown above are unchanged by
ECN-1058.
